page.layout: One printed page, full width. Digitiser's e-rara logo at top right, then title block (website, title, author, place and date, library, persistent link), a rule, licence and portal text blocks, another rule, and the Visual Library logo at bottom right. Only the title block is printed book matter; the digitiser's banner, logos and licence notices are left out.

main_text.l: Disputatio physica de passionibus mentis in genere

page.notes: The page is the digitiser's title sheet of e-rara.ch (Universitätsbibliothek Bern) for the digitised book. The text of the portal, licence notices, persistent link and logos is not printed matter of the book and has been left out. The title lines are taken from the digitiser's metadata rather than from the printed title page, so the place and date are given as shown on the sheet.
